activate_content_type.description: Publish (activate) a content type. Entries of this type cannot be created until it is activated.
activate_content_type.name: activate_content_type

parameters.description: The content type to act on, from 'List content types'.
parameters.name: content_type_id

create_asset.description: Create an asset from a URL - Contentful downloads the file itself, so no bytes are uploaded through this step. After creating it, this triggers Contentful's file processing and waits briefly for it to finish; processing is asynchronous, so a very large file may still be processing when this returns - check 'processingComplete' on the result, or run 'Get asset' again later. Leave locale empty to use the environment's default locale. Give an asset ID to choose it yourself.
create_asset.name: create_asset

parameters.description: The asset's title, shown in the Contentful web app.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: The file name to store, such as 'photo.jpg'.
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.description: The file's MIME type, such as 'image/png' or 'application/pdf'.
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.description: A URL Contentful will download the file's bytes from.
parameters.name: upload_url

parameters.description: A description of the asset.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: The locale to store the file under. Leave empty for the environment's default.
parameters.name: locale

parameters.description: A specific id for the asset. Leave empty to let Contentful generate one.
parameters.name: asset_id

create_content_type.description: Create a content type - the schema entries of this type will follow. Fields is a JSON array of field definitions, each needing an 'id', a 'name' and a 'type' (Symbol, Text, Integer, Number, Boolean, Date, Location, Object, Link, Array or RichText); a Link field also needs 'linkType' (Entry or Asset), and an Array field also needs an 'items' object naming the type each element holds. Give a content type ID to choose it yourself; leave it empty to let Contentful assign one. The content type must be activated before entries of it can be created - see 'Activate content type'.
create_content_type.name: create_content_type

parameters.description: The content type's name, shown in the Contentful web app.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: A JSON array of field definitions, e.g. [{"id": "title", "name": "Title", "type": "Symbol", "required": true}].
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: What this content type is for.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: The id of the field shown as an entry's title in the Contentful web app. Must be one of the ids in 'fields'.
parameters.name: display_field

parameters.description: A specific id for the content type, letters, numbers, underscores and dots only. Leave empty to let Contentful generate one.
parameters.name: content_type_id

create_entry.description: Create an entry of a content type. The content type must already be activated. Give an entry ID to choose it yourself; leave it empty to let Contentful assign one.
create_entry.name: create_entry

parameters.description: The content type to act on, from 'List content types'.
parameters.name: content_type_id

parameters.description: The entry's fields, wrapped per locale, exactly as Contentful stores them - for example {"title": {"en-US": "Hello"}}. Field names must match the content type's model.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: A specific id for the entry. Leave empty to let Contentful generate one.
parameters.name: entry_id

deactivate_content_type.description: Unpublish (deactivate) a content type. Every entry of this content type must already be deleted, and this must run before the content type itself can be deleted.
deactivate_content_type.name: deactivate_content_type

parameters.description: The content type to act on, from 'List content types'.
parameters.name: content_type_id

delete_asset.description: Delete an asset permanently. Must be unpublished first.
delete_asset.name: delete_asset

parameters.description: The asset to act on, from 'List assets' or 'Get asset'.
parameters.name: asset_id

delete_content_type.description: Delete a content type permanently. It must already be deactivated - see 'Deactivate content type' - with every one of its entries deleted.
delete_content_type.name: delete_content_type

parameters.description: The content type to act on, from 'List content types'.
parameters.name: content_type_id

delete_entry.description: Delete an entry permanently. Must be unpublished first.
delete_entry.name: delete_entry

parameters.description: The entry to act on, from 'List entries' or 'Get entry'.
parameters.name: entry_id

get_asset.description: Read one asset, with its file details per locale.
get_asset.name: get_asset

parameters.description: The asset to act on, from 'List assets' or 'Get asset'.
parameters.name: asset_id

get_content_type.description: Read one content type in full: its fields, display field and description.
get_content_type.name: get_content_type

parameters.description: The content type to act on, from 'List content types'.
parameters.name: content_type_id

get_entry.description: Read one entry, with its fields wrapped per locale.
get_entry.name: get_entry

parameters.description: The entry to act on, from 'List entries' or 'Get entry'.
parameters.name: entry_id

list_assets.description: List assets (media files) in this space and environment.
list_assets.name: list_assets

parameters.description: Only assets whose text matches this full-text search.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: How many to return, 1-100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip, for paging past the first page.
parameters.name: skip

has_more.description: Whether another page exists past this one

list_content_types.description: List the content types defined in this space and environment - the schemas that entries are created from. Each one reports its id, name, description, display field and field definitions.
list_content_types.name: list_content_types

parameters.description: How many to return, 1-100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip, for paging past the first page.
parameters.name: skip

has_more.description: Whether another page exists past this one

list_entries.description: List entries, optionally narrowed to one content type or to text matching a full-text search.
list_entries.name: list_entries

parameters.description: Only entries of this content type. Leave empty for all types.
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.description: Only entries whose text matches this full-text search.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: A field to sort by, such as 'sys.createdAt' or '-sys.createdAt' for newest first.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: How many to return, 1-100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip, for paging past the first page.
parameters.name: skip

has_more.description: Whether another page exists past this one

list_locales.description: List the locales configured for this environment. Every entry and asset field is stored per locale, and exactly one locale here is marked 'default'.
list_locales.name: list_locales

publish_asset.description: Publish an asset, making it live on the Content Delivery API. The file must already be processed (have a URL) - 'Create asset' does this automatically.
publish_asset.name: publish_asset

parameters.description: The asset to act on, from 'List assets' or 'Get asset'.
parameters.name: asset_id

publish_entry.description: Publish an entry, making it live on the Content Delivery API.
publish_entry.name: publish_entry

parameters.description: The entry to act on, from 'List entries' or 'Get entry'.
parameters.name: entry_id

unpublish_asset.description: Unpublish an asset. Required before it can be deleted.
unpublish_asset.name: unpublish_asset

parameters.description: The asset to act on, from 'List assets' or 'Get asset'.
parameters.name: asset_id

unpublish_entry.description: Unpublish an entry. Required before it can be deleted.
unpublish_entry.name: unpublish_entry

parameters.description: The entry to act on, from 'List entries' or 'Get entry'.
parameters.name: entry_id

update_entry.description: Replace an entry's fields. This replaces the whole fields object rather than merging - include every field you want to keep, not only the ones changing.
update_entry.name: update_entry

parameters.description: The entry to act on, from 'List entries' or 'Get entry'.
parameters.name: entry_id

parameters.description: The entry's fields, wrapped per locale, exactly as Contentful stores them - for example {"title": {"en-US": "Hello"}}. Field names must match the content type's model.
parameters.name: fields

description: Manage content in Contentful: create and publish content types, entries and media assets, and read back what is already there. Content types define the schema; entries hold the content; assets hold the media.
